t: You're facing the Lyric Hammersmith, a nonprofit theatre on Lyric Square, just off King Street. It was designed by Frank Matcham, an English architect who specialised in theatres and music halls. Over a forty-year career he was responsible for more than ninety theatres, and redesigned or refurbished around eighty more. He worked extensively in London, so this is one of many stages that carry his mark, here in Hammersmith.
